statements.statement: The procedure code billed was CPT 93229
The diagnosis codes were I49.9 and R00.2
The denial reason code was CO-197
The patient presents with intermittent episodes of palpitations and a sensation of irregular heartbeat without a clear precipitating factor
The symptoms are non-sustained in nature
There is a need for extended rhythm correlation
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture potential arrhythmic events over a prolonged monitoring period
The denial was based on failure to obtain required precertification or prior authorization before services were rendered
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring was medically necessary
